name: 公示による通知方法を変更
summary: 聴聞の通知などを公示で行う場合、これまでは行政庁の事務所の掲示場に通知事項などを掲示していました。この議案で、公示事項を総務省令で定める方法で不特定多数の人が閲覧できるようにし、事務所の掲示場への掲示か、事務所内の電子画面での閲覧も行います。措置を始めてから2週間が過ぎると、通知が届いたものとみなします。
changes: 総務省令で定める方法で、公示事項を不特定多数の人が閲覧できる状態にする
公示事項を事務所の掲示場に掲示するか、事務所内の電子画面で閲覧できるようにする
who: 不利益処分の対象となり、公示による通知を受ける人
why: 行政手続法の改正に伴い、聴聞の通知などに係る公示送達をデジタル化するためと、区は説明しています。

en.name: Changes how notices are given by public notice
en.official: Ordinance Partially Amending the Meguro City Administrative Procedure Ordinance
en.summary: When notices of hearings and similar matters are given by public notice, the details of the notice have until now been posted on a notice board at the administrative agency's office. Under this bill, the details of the public notice will be made viewable by an unspecified number of people using a method prescribed by Ministry of Internal Affairs and Communications ordinance. They will also be posted on a notice board at the office or made viewable on an electronic screen inside the office. Once two weeks have passed after the measure begins, the notice will be considered delivered.
changes: Make the details of a public notice viewable by an unspecified number of people using a method prescribed by Ministry of Internal Affairs and Communications ordinance
Post the details of a public notice on a notice board at the office or make them viewable on an electronic screen inside the office
who: People subject to an adverse disposition who receive notice by public notice
en.why: The ward says the change is to digitalize service by public notice for notices of hearings and similar matters, following revisions to the Administrative Procedure Act.
